$comment: The one definition of this site's identity (Search Readiness k1, k4). The pages are hand-written HTML, so scripts/validate-site.mjs holds every page's Organization node in its JSON-LD to this file: name, url, logo, sameAs and parentOrganization must match it exactly, or CI fails. sameAs lists only profiles that resolve now; anything not yet claimed goes in profiles_pending.
